messages:
Maria (product): FYI — Hannah just flagged a Monarch Insurance request for a private deployment. want to triage scope and decide if it goes to backlog.
Hannah (sales): Monarch wants VPC+on-prem option, HSM for keys, air-gapped option later. timeline asked: 8-12 weeks. potential ARR: mid-size, heavy compliance.
Sam (solutions): Can you paste the ask + any compliance docs? curious if they require FIPS/HSM certs or just BYOK.
Hannah (sales): pasted ticket: https://app.internal/tickets/MC-4721 — summary: private control plane in their VPC, data plane can be on-prem, KMS+HSM integration, audit logs to Splunk, HA across 2 DCs optional.
Ravi (eng): Quick gut: 8-12 weeks is tight if they want full airgap + HSM. We need infra work (networking, installation script), installer packaging, and a hardened KMS path. Also certs for HSM vendor.
Elaine (security): Need to confirm exact compliance target (SOC2 vs PCI vs FedRAMP). Different requirements. Also will need a threat model review and audit logging primitives before GA.
Maria (product): Proposal: split into MVP private deployment (VPC-only + KMS via customer KMS over TLS, no airgap, single DC) vs Full-onprem airgapped with HSM + HA. Treat full as enterprise integration project. Prioritize MVP to backlog if sales agrees.
Sam (solutions): +1. Sales can sell MVP while we scope the provable steps for full. What are launch criteria for MVP?
Ravi (eng): Minimal launch criteria (dev checklist):
```
- Automated installer for customer VPC (terraform + bootstrap)
- KMS integration over mutual TLS (customer-managed keys)
- Basic audit log export to S3/Splunk
- Basic RBAC + API tokens + rotation docs
- Runbook for upgrades and rollback
- Smoke tests for latency and token routing
```
These are dev tasks, estimate 6-8w for an engineering squad to deliver if no weird vendor blockers.
Hannah (sales): Monarch will likely pay a setup fee and want SLA. Need to confirm SLA expectations (99.9%?) and who owns on-prem infra incidents.
Maria (product): Action: Hannah to confirm SLA + compliance box (which regs). Ravi to draft technical dependency checklist and vendor risk (HSM makes things longer). Sam to prepare customer-facing MVP scope doc. Elaine to schedule threat model review. Target: sync next Wed.
Hannah (sales): I’ll confirm SLA and ask about preferred HSM vendors.
Ravi (eng): Draft checklist snippet:
```
- Customer VPC peering and CIDR plan
- Host provisioning (OS + deps) automation
- Network ACLs + firewall rules
- KMS endpoint + cert exchange process
- Storage encryption at rest verified
- Monitoring agent & log forwarder installed
```
Putting major vendor integrations (HSM, airgap) in separate epics.
Maria (product): Prioritization note: this is mid-high priority given money and reference value, but needs product/engineering lead assigned before we pull into next sprint.
intake-bot: Ticket MC-4721 assigned to product backlog as candidate, priority: P2.
Sam (solutions): I’ll take owner for the customer-facing MVP scope doc. assigning to myself in Jira.
Elaine (security): Once Hannah confirms regs, I’ll add required controls and audit checklist. Might add ~2w of security work.
Hannah (sales): Monarch confirmed SOC2 + wants HSM (Entrust preferred). Also asked if we can do limited airgap later.
Ravi (eng): Entrust HSM is supported but we need their HSM APIs and cert exchange — vendor contact will add lead time. Changing timeline: MVP = 9-10w, full airgap + HSM = 14-18w.
Maria (product): OK — capture estimates in intake ticket and mark dependencies (vendor contacts, legal for contracts, security review). If all agree, we push MVP into backlog with label: private-deploy-mvp and target milestone Q2-3.
Sam (solutions): :thumbsup: will draft the doc today and link to ticket.
Hannah (sales): Thanks team — I’ll update the customer on the staged approach (MVP then airgap).
Maria (product): Closing notes: owners: Sam (scope doc), Ravi (tech checklist + eng estimate), Elaine (security controls), Hannah (customer comms). Follow-up sync next Wed 10am PT. :calendar:
